review_conservation.rule: Deferred review is a conserved obligation, not implicit acceptance or a universal construction gate. Implementation, execution and review coverage are independent. Refinement must deepen realization, critically inspect touched inherited code/architecture/causal tests and integration, and explicitly discharge or carry forward each relevant outstanding scope. Record exact source and consumer, reviewer identity and independence, scope/path/symbol, depth/method, verdict, limits and remaining scope. Distinguish author inspection, author execution and independent review; retain prior receipts at their original revisions, mark stale/nontransferable after source or dependency change unless explicit equivalence is established. A same-author refinement is not independent review. Only consequential defects/contested evidence enter existing REMONT; missing functionality and deferred review remain here. No separate register or automatic review commission.

review_conservation.discharge: Retain stable obligation IDs; record reviewed and residual subscopes plus source revision, reviewer, independence, scope/depth, verdict and evidence. CO.exact_opening: **CURRENT AUTHOR-BRANCH SINGLE THEORY HOME — DCO R16 · NOVEMBER 23, 2026 · PROTECTED PROGRAMMA RECEIVING NOT CLAIMED.** This manuscript reconstitutes all 92 original substantive subsections and all 17 original movement introductory records

**Historical section-number rule:** Within preserved R15 source determinations, phrases such as “Movement XII,” “Section XVI,” “the current seventeen movements” and earlier version references describe the **R15 historical organization**, no

**Method:** This is not an edited digest or an anthology claiming a new theory by the presence of a preface. Each of the twelve new movements argues a causal junction and recomposes inherited determinations *across* old chapter boundaries.

**Single central proposition:** This organism is one particular, continuing, historically generated life. Its material and social reality is independent; its psychology is neither a universal trait menu nor a transparent self-narrative; its

The strongest claim is not that many factors influence Nadia. That proposition could be satisfied by placing variables next to one another while leaving them causally inert. The claim is that **Nadia's acquired means of having a life are th

Begin with an ordinary interval, not a dramatic scene. Nadia travels to work. Her body carries sleep debt, hunger, motor skill and habitual routes of attention. She notices an ordinary object, perhaps a repair in a shop window, but may be t

No event in this example requires a newly invented “trigger.” Her current history was already active. Nor does a meaningful possibility require an externally planned lesson: an accidental tool use, a gesture overheard, remembered success, p
